Episodes.Title: Sumabog sa Galit at Inggit si Miguel
Hinding-Hindi Pakakawalan ni Miguel si Mercy
S1.E51 ∙ Bagong yugto
Episodes.Description: As the new chapter begins, Miguel's evil plan against Abra also begins.

Episodes.Title: S1.E52 ∙ Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Miguel's plan to bring down Benito and Abra together continues. He orders Atoy and Nina to carry out the evil plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E53 ∙ Annulment
Episodes.Description: When Miguel receives Mercy's petition for annulment, he also discovers a major truth about Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E54 ∙ Tunay na ama
Episodes.Description: Mercy finally tells Abra that he's the father of Fatima. Miguel has become more determined than ever to reunite his family upon receiving the annulment papers.

Episodes.Title: S1.E55 ∙ Dehado
Episodes.Description: A surprise armed attack on the Balmores mansion led to an unexpected outcome. Meanwhile, Abra confronts Miguel at the law firm after getting ahold of Balmores' signed Durable Power Of Attorney.

Episodes.Title: S1.E56 ∙ Fake Hero
Episodes.Description: After Miguel's plan to get Abra arrested succeeds, he takes another step further by "rescuing" Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E57 ∙ Manipula
Episodes.Description: Mercy confronts Miguel after visiting his mansion. Meanwhile, Abra is determined to get out of the provincial jail as quickly as possible, but danger lurks in every corner.

Episodes.Title: S1.E58 ∙ Kasunduan
Episodes.Description: Abra finally confronts Atoy about his motivation to set Abra up after being transferred to the same jail cell. Jane persuades Bea to cut ties with Tom.

Episodes.Title: S1.E59 ∙ Riot
Episodes.Description: After hearing the news from the jail warden that Abra is about to be released from the provincial jail, Miguel orders the jail warden to set a final trap against Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E60 ∙ Pangontra
Episodes.Description: After reuniting, Abra and Mercy talk about their next plan to rescue Fatima. Miguel enlists the help of Jane to ruin Abra's public image. Brando is beginning to question Abra's loyalty to Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E61 ∙ Bihag
Episodes.Description: Abra's promise to help Atoy rescue Fatima comes to fruition. With the help of his team, they set their plan in motion by going to Atoy's employer's house, Balat.

Episodes.Title: S1.E63 ∙ Salisi
Episodes.Description: A homesick Fatima attempts to escape from their house after being kept from her mother and grandfather by Miguel for so long. Bea gets the courage to ask Tom for an unusual favor.

Episodes.Title: S1.E64 ∙ Kampihan
Episodes.Description: Abra has become desperate to find help with an unlikely acquaintance after exhausting his options to find and rescue Fatima. Meanwhile, Miguel and Fatima's relationship worsens.

Episodes.Title: S1.E65 ∙ Utakan
Episodes.Description: As Abra and his team uncover Fatima's location, they prepare themselves in a race against time after Jane breaks the news about Miguel's plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E66 ∙ Sagip
Episodes.Description: After failing to get to Miguel's house on time, Abra and his team work together to catch Miguel's car and rescue Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E67 ∙ Damdamin
Episodes.Description: Abra successfully rescues Fatima, reuniting her with Mercy. Meanwhile, a desperate Miguel contacts Jane in the hopes of involving her in another one of his schemes.

Episodes.Title: S1.E68 ∙ Alinlangan
Episodes.Description: Jane's in deep water after Miguel sends her to gather information to use against Abra. Meanwhile, Brando suspects something out of Abra and Mercy's real relationship.

Episodes.Title: S1.E69 ∙ Kadugo
Episodes.Description: As Mercy learns about Elizabeth, her half-sister--- her dismay toward Judge Benito grows stronger. Norman and Obet escorts Atoy and Nina in leaving Rosario, with Miguel's men in hot pursuit.

Episodes.Title: S1.E70 ∙ Power
Episodes.Description: Already furious about Abra's involvement in the escape of Atoy, Miguel's wrath can be felt inside the Balmores Law firm as Mercy arrives together with Abra to assert her power as an Attorney-in-fact of Judge Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E71 ∙ Takeover
Episodes.Description: Miguel intends to kill Abra as he learns the latter confirms its attendance in the upcoming Alamid meeting, his father opposes the idea. Meanwhile, Mercy notices that Fatima develops a trauma after the kidnapping incident. Abra vows to do everything to stop Miguel from hurting them again.

Episodes.Title: S1.E72 ∙ Pag-amin
Episodes.Description: Abra gets carried away and confesses his love to Mercy. With Fatima's safety in jeopardy, Mercy decides to set aside her real feelings. Meanwhile, Jane can't stand seeing Abra, her one great love-- hurting over unrequited love. It pains her too.

Episodes.Title: S1.E73 ∙ Sawi
Episodes.Description: After an awkward drunken encounter with Abra, Jane begins to distance herself from Abra. Meanwhile, Elizabeth finally arrives at the Balmores mansion to live with her half-sister, Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E74 ∙ Panggulo
Episodes.Description: Abra finally meets Elizabeth, Mercy's estranged half-sister. Miguel brews a new sinister plan after losing most of what he cherishes.

Episodes.Title: S1.E75 ∙ Buwelta
Episodes.Description: Miguel calls for a meeting with the Alamid members to complete his plan. Despite warnings from his friends and allies, Abra is still determined to attend the Alamid meeting.

Episodes.Title: S1.E76 ∙ Bagsik
Episodes.Description: As the meeting between Alamid members begins, an unexpected guest shows up that shakes up Miguel's plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E77 ∙ Kastigo
Episodes.Description: The return of Benito Balmores from a coma turned Miguel's plan upside down. Miguel takes Abra hostage as he runs away with his father, Mario, to escape the newly awakened judge's wrath.

Episodes.Title: S1.E78 ∙ Pugante
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of Miguel's escape, Abra was hospitalized due to his injuries while fighting Miguel. Benito tasked his subordinates to hunt down Miguel and brands him as a fugitive in Rosario.

Episodes.Title: S1.E79 ∙ Pangamba
Episodes.Description: With Benito Balmores' return to power, Abra and Mercy agree to protect their daughter, Fatima from her grandfather. Meanwhile, Atoy and Nina continue to live a peaceful life despite potential threats looming over them.

Episodes.Title: S1.E80 ∙ Kontrolado
Episodes.Description: Benito calls for a meeting with his subordinates to discuss their next move against Miguel. Atoy and Nina argue about their situation and involvement in helping Abra fight against Benito Balmores.

Episodes.Title: S1.E81 ∙ Tiwala
Episodes.Description: Abra tries to contact Atoy but to no avail. Corcerned about Nina and Atoy's safety, Abra and friends goes to their last known location-- only to discover that they were no longer staying there. Benito's suspicion rises and for Abra to regain the judge's trust again, he agrees to take a special mission with Elizabeth as his partner in crime.

Episodes.Title: S1.E82 ∙ Prinsipyo
Episodes.Description: While on a mission, Abra struggles to let go of his principles. Elizabeth senses it and uses Abra's moral dilemma to her advantage. Meanwhile, Mercy follows Brando. Abra's involvement in her father's dirty deed saddens the clueless Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E83 ∙ Konsensya
Episodes.Description: Because of Abra's involvement, Mercy decides not to use the video footage against Judge Benito Balmores. Abra reassures Mercy; he finally confesses to her.

Episodes.Title: S1.E84 ∙ Alyansa
Episodes.Description: Due to constant involvement in violence, Atty. Abra struggles to believe that he is still a good man fighting an evil man. In the end, Mercy convinces the attorney to help her with her candidacy; their only hope to take the evil judge down.

Episodes.Title: S1.E85 ∙ Tindig
Episodes.Description: Mercy finally announces to the public that she will run as a governor of Rosario; promising to eradicate corruption first if elected; upon hearing Mercy's true agenda-- Judge Balmores withdraws his support for Mercy's candidacy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E86 ∙ Mothering
Episodes.Description: Mercy is finally breaking free from Benito's control. Meanwhile, Mother Eu is helping Miguel rise up to seek revenge against Benito and regain power in Rosario.

Episodes.Title: S1.E87 ∙ Sanib pwersa
Episodes.Description: Abra is about to introduce Mercy to his allies who will help her in her fight to win the election. However, Benito will quickly find a way to bring Mercy back under his control.

Episodes.Title: S1.E88 ∙ Sabotahe
Episodes.Description: Due to Benito's sabotage of potential financiers for Mercy's campaign, Abra and Jane will find a way to counter it. Meanwhile, Mother Eu and Miguel are planning how to attack Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E89 ∙ Pagkakataon
Episodes.Description: Because of Abra, Mr. Sampaga agrees to a meeting to hear Mercy's plans-but with one condition Abra must attend; otherwise, he won't talk to a Balmores. As the scheduled time for their meeting approaches, Benito summons Abra for a mission.

Episodes.Title: S1.E90 ∙ Paghimok
Episodes.Description: Besides the importance of convincing Mr. Sampaga for his support, it is even more crucial to gain the trust of the people. The battle for Mercy Balmores' candidacy is about to begin.

Episodes.Title: S1.E91 ∙ Paramdam
Episodes.Description: Miguel's presence resurfaces in Rosario, and the first thing he disrupts is Mercy's campaign. Meanwhile, Benito's violence is felt as he searches for those supporting Mercy's candidacy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E92 ∙ Lusob
Episodes.Description: Due to Elizabeth's surveillance, Mercy's financier is confirmed. Mr. Sampaga's life is in danger because of Judge Balmores' sinister plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E93 ∙ Responde
Episodes.Description: Mother Eu and Miguel leave a message at the gate of the Balmores Mansion Manong's corpse.

Episodes.Title: S1.E94 ∙ Tatsulok
Episodes.Description: Although Mr. Sampaga was successfully rescued, Jane's happiness is incomplete due to the rekindled closeness between Mercy and Abra. Confessions are about to be made.

Episodes.Title: S1.E95 ∙ Blackmail
Episodes.Description: As the Alamid forces continue to grow, so does the intensification of plans to bring down Mercy's candidacy. Under pressure from Elizabeth, Abra is forced to confess to Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E96 ∙ Babala
Episodes.Description: Miguel warns Benito and Abra about his revenge. Jane also learns about Miguel's next plan to take back Mercy and Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E97 ∙ Pagsangga
Episodes.Description: During Miguel's assault, Mercy and Fatima find themselves threatened, but Abra intervenes to protect them, putting himself in grave danger.

Episodes.Title: S1.E98 ∙ Lamat
Episodes.Description: Despite Mercy's improving position in the election, Benito begins to suspect Abra's true nature.

Episodes.Title: S1.E99 ∙ Troll Farm
Episodes.Description: As the relationship between Benito and Abra continues to deteriorate, Mother Eu and Miguel plan to take them down. Mother Eu suggests finding out any secret about Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E100 ∙ Hinala
Episodes.Description: The smear campaigns and character assassination against Mercy seem to be succeeding. Meanwhile, as Abra attacks the troll farm, a lurking danger awaits.

Episodes.Title: S1.E101 ∙ Pag-usig
Episodes.Description: Benito confronts Abra for the sabotage at the troll farm. Meanwhile, Miguel reappears to introduce Jane to Mother Eu.

Episodes.Title: S1.E102 ∙ Pandaraya
Episodes.Description: Benito offers a coalition to Gov. Uy to ensure victory in the election against Mercy. Jane worries about Abra's safety, especially since Benito now harbors significant suspicion about him.

Episodes.Title: S1.E103 ∙ Pananakot
Episodes.Description: Abra and Mercy face the task of vote-buying. However, Benito orders Brando to get ahead of Abra and Mercy.

Episodes.Title: S1.E104 ∙ Salba
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth offers to team up with Abra by providing an information. Masked Abra tries to save Kap Rodel from brando's men-- endangering his cover.

Episodes.Title: S1.E105 ∙ Pagtutuos
Episodes.Description: Overjoyed by their small victory, Mercy and Abra takes a little moment to appreciate each other. Fueled by anger and jealousy, Miguel tails Abra's car as danger awaits them both.

Episodes.Title: S1.E106 ∙ Kapit
Episodes.Description: Almost defeated in a fist fight by Abra, Miguel manages to get his hands near Jane and Mercy--using them for a chance to escape. Abra, literally holding both Mercy and Jane's life in the palm of his hand--who can he save?

Episodes.Title: S1.E107 ∙ Takot
Episodes.Description: Jane's finally in an stable condition. As the accident leaves no alarming physical damage, it brings big impact to Abra and Jane's relationship. Will Abra be able to win her trust again?

Episodes.Title: S1.E108 ∙ Asintado
Episodes.Description: Ready, aim, shoot. As the election day draws nearer, Elizabeth agrees to do a dangerous mission. Someone's going to get bloody, who would it be?

Episodes.Title: S1.E109 ∙ Hitman
Episodes.Description: As Leonardo learns who orchestrated the assassination attempt--a more shocking revelation unfolds.

Episodes.Title: S1.E110 ∙ Laglagan
Episodes.Description: Abra saves Elizabeth from Benito's corrupt policemen. Meanwhile, nightmares starts to haunt Jane in her sleep.

Episodes.Title: S1.E111 ∙ Prayoridad
Episodes.Description: Brando suspects Abra of hiding Elizabeth and pays a surprise visit to his home; As Abra visits Jane in the hospital, Brando and his men searches Abra's house leaving the lone Elizabeth in an exposed location.

Episodes.Title: S1.E112 ∙ Pagtanggap
Episodes.Description: Fearing that Benito's men will soon find Elizabeth, Abra brings her to the safehouse. Hesitant at first, but through Abra's convincing-- the group agrees to give Elizabeth another chance.

Episodes.Title: S1.E113 ∙ Hikayat
Episodes.Description: Furious at Abra for exposing the groups safehouse to an enemy, Jane angrily confronts both Elizabeth and Abra. To prove her sincerity, Elizabeth reveals Benito's plan to ambush Mercy's supporters on election day.

Episodes.Title: S1.E114 ∙ Mass Grave
Episodes.Description: In the middle of the rescue mission, Elizabeth sacrifices herself to be the target of Brando and his goons. Giving Jane and Abra the opportunity to pull Kap Ed and his people out of the mass grave.

Episodes.Title: S1.E115 ∙ Gahol
Episodes.Description: Abra, Jane, and the voters chase the cutoff for voting. Abra is very grateful to Elizabeth for helping stop Benito's evil plan. However, Jane still doubts Elizabeth's intentions. The true results of the election are about to be revealed.

Episodes.Title: S1.E116 ∙ Protesta
Episodes.Description: In the midst of Mercy's defeat in the election, she and Abra, with the help of the voters, are protesting the true results. Atoy, meanwhile, is resurfacing to fulfill his promise to Abra.

Episodes.Title: S1.E117 ∙ Protesta
Episodes.Description: Abra is filled with hope again because of the new plan with Atoy. But even before they meet, Elizabeth sabotages him.

Episodes.Title: S1.E118 ∙ Hinanakit
Episodes.Description: Brando tails Abra en route to Atoy's place. As he finds Nina, Brando kills her first. Abra and Atoys manages to escape successfully. Grieving Atoy regrets reconnecting with Abra and blames him for Nina's death.

Episodes.Title: S1.E119 ∙ Sabwatan
Episodes.Description: Jane reassures Miguel about there plan against Benito. Although defeated, Mercy continues her public service, gaining the support of an eye witness-- enough to file an electoral protest against Leonardo Uy. Meanwhile, through Elizabeth's help, Judge Benito is already aware about the name's of Abra's inner group.

Episodes.Title: S1.E120 ∙ Moralidad
Episodes.Description: Mercy brings a new witness to Abra against Gov. Uy's election fraud. However, Norman's fears for the witness's safety prevail. Meanwhile, Jane is gradually changing. Mother Eu and Miguel are putting together a big plan to finally bring down Benito.

Episodes.Title: S1.E121 ∙ Lihis
Episodes.Description: An expose about last election's anomaly gets trending online. Gov Leonardo Uy orders the warrantless arrest for Mercy Balmores. Meanwhile, drunk Atoy accidentally reveals to Elizabeth some information about Abra's true identity.

Episodes.Title: S1.E122 ∙ Kantian
Episodes.Description: Upon learning that it is Gov Leonardo who orders the illegal arrest of Mercy, armed and furious Benito Balmores rushes to confront Gov Uy on his own turf.

Episodes.Title: S1.E123 ∙ Tanim
Episodes.Description: As Benito Balmores plans to eliminate Mercy's star witness, Miguel is already making his way inside the Alamid's safehouse with only one thing in mind-- burn them all.

Episodes.Title: S1.E124 ∙ Sumbatan
Episodes.Description: To gather more information, Abra decides to attend the Alamid's welcoming ritual. Fearing for Abra's life, Jane warns and tries to stop him-- revealing her own involvement in Miguel's dark plan.

Episodes.Title: S1.E125 ∙ Pasabog
Episodes.Description: Elizabeth's work inside Abra's camp finally pays off, with her help Benito finally discovers that Abra's true identity is Norman Dela Cruz. Meanwhile, Miguel is itching to push the trigger that will end not only Benito but the whole Alamid.

Episodes.Title: S1.E126 ∙ Ikatlong buhay
Episodes.Description: One by one, Pido and Obet detonates the bombs by cutting the right wires. It delays the explosion but clever Miguel activates the second detonator and KABOOM.

Episodes.Title: S1.E127 ∙ Eskapo
Episodes.Description: Jane tries to stop Miguel, a change of heart at the last minute. But unsuccessful and overpowered, from accomplice she becomes the hostage of Miguel and Mother Eu as they escape the scene.

Episodes.Title: S1.E128 ∙ Gigil
Episodes.Description: Abra manages to bring Benito with him as he jumps out of the building before the explosion. Ungrateful Benito orders Brando to track down and kill Norman Dela Cruz. While on the run, Norman plans to rescue Jane from Miguel. It's hunting season.

Episodes.Title: S1.E129 ∙ Bitag
Episodes.Description: Utilizing Jane as bait, Miguel is convinced he can lure Norman into his trap. Aware of the danger, Norman still insists on rescuing Jane.

Episodes.Title: S1.E130 ∙ Bintang
Episodes.Description: Using his power and connections, Benito places the blame for the recent bombing on Miguel and Norman. With the authorities chasing Norman, will he still be able to save Jane?

Episodes.Title: S1.E131 ∙ Atake
Episodes.Description: Leveraging his sharp wit, Norman, with the help of Obet and Pido, takes Miguel by surprise, disorienting Mother Eu and the rest of her goons. Meanwhile, Brando finds Mercy's hideout.

Episodes.Title: S1.E132 ∙ Salpukan
Episodes.Description: Unwilling to concede, Miguel continues to chase Norman's group. Along the way, Brando spots Norman while fleeing from Miguel. A heavy gunfight forces Norman and his group to take shelter in an abandoned building. Meanwhile, Miguel gets a chance to capture Mercy and Fatima.

Episodes.Title: S1.E133 ∙ Lugmok
Episodes.Description: Enraged, Norman is now convinced that there is no other way to stop evil but to kill both Benito and Miguel.

Episodes.Title: S1.E134 ∙ Pagkamuhi
Episodes.Description: Jane tries to apologize for her role in Miguel's plan, but Mercy finds it hard to forget everything. Meanwhile, a rift in Mother Eu and Miguel's partnership pushes them to part ways.

Episodes.Title: S1.E135 ∙ Unang pagdating
Episodes.Description: The mysterious assassin who helps Jane against Mother Eu and Miguel finally reveals herself-it's Christine. Who is she to Benito?

Episodes.Title: S1.E136 ∙ Peligro
Episodes.Description: As Norman's group exits Rosario, Fatima shows symptoms of a seizure, forcing them to stop and find a nearby hospital, which gives Brando and Miguel time to catch up.

Episodes.Title: S1.E137 ∙ Tugis
Episodes.Description: Still unsuccessful in tracking Norman, Brando notices Miguel on a motorbike following their vehicle from afar. Feeling lucky, he devises a plan to trap Miguel.

Episodes.Title: S1.E138 ∙ Walang iwanan
Episodes.Description: Now a fugitive and aware that Benito will do anything to kill him, Norman urges the group to escape and save themselves-yet his friends decide to stay no matter what.

Episodes.Title: S1.E139 ∙ Tagisan
Episodes.Description: Miguel learns where Norman might be hiding. Meanwhile, Fatima opens up about her small wish.

Episodes.Title: S1.E140 ∙ Family
Episodes.Description: Norman is determined to leave Rosario and build a quiet family with Mercy and Fatima. At the same time, events in Rosario align with Balmores' plans. Two former allies will betray each other.

Entries.Title: Prinsesa ng City Jail
Entries.Description: Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) agony as a convict worsens as she has no choice but to deal with the presence of Divina (Denise Laurel), her fellow convict and the bitter ex-lover of her partner.

Episodes.Title: The revival of pregnant convicts’ dispute
Episodes.Description: Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) agony as a convict worsens as she has no choice but to deal with the presence of Divina (Denise Laurel), her fellow convict and the bitter ex-lover of her partner.

Episodes.Title: Baligtad na kapalaran
Episodes.Description: Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) and Divina (Denise Laurel) simultaneously give birth to their children, and the latter is compelled to switch her baby with the former's as her payback after being deprived from her supposed wealthy life.

Episodes.Title: Baby Girl
Episodes.Description: Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) and Divina (Denise Laurel) finally savor their liberty following their release from jail, but the inmates are left with a baby girl abandoned by the latter.

Episodes.Title: Bagong pamilya
Episodes.Description: As Princess (Sofia Pablo) grows, Dado (Keempee De Leon) writes fake letters to make it appear that she has a mother staying in Kuwait. However, he eventually stops when she becomes a teenager due to his guilt of giving his daughter false hope.

Episodes.Title: First Meeting
Episodes.Description: With her goal of finding her mother in Kuwait, Princess (Sofia Pablo) begins working to save money. Will everything go according to plan?

Episodes.Title: Fake vs Real
Episodes.Description: Princess (Sofia Pablo) is overjoyed upon receiving another letter from her mother after years of waiting. However, she later notices Bernard’s (Jett Pangan) penmanship, leading her to suspect that Dado (Keempee De Leon) made her believe in fake letters all along

Episodes.Title: Valedictory speech is dedicated to parents!
Episodes.Description: Princess (Sofia Pablo) and Dado (Keempee De Leon) remain distant to each other after their confrontation about her mother. Later, she delivers her valedictory speech in dedication to her parents despite their absence during her most-awaited milestone.

Episodes.Title: Inmates are proud of their valedictorian!
Episodes.Description: Princess (Sofia Pablo) finally reconciles with Dado (Keempee De Leon), and the latter arranges a special graduation ceremony in the city jail to make up for his absence. Later, Princess expresses her eagerness to reach out to her mother, and Onse (Will Ashley) assists by posting a video of her online.

Episodes.Title: Princess has finally found her mother!
Episodes.Description: While Princess (Sofia Pablo) continues to receive multiple scam messages during her search for her mother, she still accepts Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzales) invitation to meet her in the latter’s shop.

Episodes.Title: A new trial will come into Dado’s life
Episodes.Description: Dado’s (Keempee de Leon) world is about to be shaken once again, as he discovers a life-threatening illness that will change everything for him and Princess (Sofia Pablo).

Episodes.Title: Princess shows resilience for her father!
Episodes.Description: Despite another heartbreak upon discovering Dado’s (Keempee De Leon) incurable disease, Princess (Sofia Pablo) assures her father that she will never get tired of taking care of him while hoping for a miracle.

Episodes.Title: Divina desires to meet her valued client!
Episodes.Description: When Divina (Denise Laurel) hears the name of their family client for a grand birthday celebration, her sudden interest leads her to insist on personally welcoming them.

Episodes.Title: Princess bears the blame for ruined party!
Episodes.Description: Liberty (Lauren King) keeps an eye on Xavier (Allen Ansay) and Princess (Sofia Pablo) during the grand celebration until she can no longer resist assaulting the latter again, resulting in a scandalous scene that disappoints all the guests.

Episodes.Title: Divina reunites with her favorite couple!
Episodes.Description: Not long after the ruined celebration, Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) intends to talk to the restaurant owner when Divina (Denise Laurel) coincidentally shows up, carrying the pride of living luxuriously.

Episodes.Title: Divina is about to bring drama!
Episodes.Description: After their last meeting, it’s clear that Divina (Denise Laurel) has no plans of stopping her meddling in Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzalez) life, especially with her own agenda regarding the latter's daughter.

Episodes.Title: Sharlene becomes Princess' good samaritan!
Episodes.Description: Amidst Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) breakdown, Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) immediately reaches out upon seeing her again. As the former opens up about her family crisis, the latter unhesitatingly hires her as a new staff member in the shop—despite the likelihood of Liberty (Lauren King) opposing her mother's decision.

Episodes.Title: Divina wishes to meet her daughter!
Episodes.Description: While Divina (Denise Laurel) is hopeful to meet her daughter in the upcoming awards night, Liberty (Lauren King) seems to lose interest in her family commitments due to her relationship problem with Xavier (Allen Ansay).

Episodes.Title: The city jail princess rescues her prince!
Episodes.Description: Princess (Sofia Pablo) coincidentally happens to be in the same area where Xavier (Allen Ansay) gets attacked by a burglar, so she immediately steps in to defend him and helps him manage his trauma trigger.

Episodes.Title: The mother and daughter feel betrayed!
Episodes.Description: Liberty (Lauren King) dwells on her heartbreak after catching Xavier (Allen Ansay) and Princess (Sofia Pablo) together again. Meanwhile, Divina’s (Denise Laurel) husband wants a divorce as he is aware that his wife is just after his riches.

Episodes.Title: Divina seeks custody of her daughter
Episodes.Description: Now that Divina (Denise Laurel) knows the truth, what will be her next action after knowing that Liberty (Lauren King) is her daughter?

Episodes.Title: Liberty takes side with her Mommy D!
Episodes.Description: Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) is enraged upon discovering that Divina (Denise Laurel) has been influencing her daughter and orders Liberty (Lauren King) to distance herself away from the latter. However, Liberty holds on to her belief that her “Mommy D” is her true ally over her own mother.

Episodes.Title: Liberty HATES her Mommy Sharlene!
Episodes.Description: Divina (Denise Laurel) fuels her daughter’s grudge against Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) by exposing the latter’s secret employment of Princess (Sofia Pablo). However, Liberty’s (Lauren King) reckless act of harassing Princess at the shop immediately results in her own backlash.

Episodes.Title: Liberty follows her Mommy D’s teaching!
Episodes.Description: While everyone appreciates Liberty’s (Lauren King) sudden change of heart toward Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) and Princess (Sofia Pablo), Divina (Denise Laurel) remains proud of her daughter for taking part in her evil plan.

Episodes.Title: Divina and Liberty start a sabotage mission!
Episodes.Description: While Liberty (Lauren King) secretly plays dirty amidst her fake kindness towards Princess (Sofia Pablo), Divina (Denise Laurel) finds ways to get close to Raymond (Dominic Ochoa) and Sonya (Jean Saburit).

Episodes.Title: Xavier's birthday celebration turns into a disaster!
Episodes.Description: Libby (Lauren King) plots another evil scheme against Princess (Sofia Pablo) to ruin Xavier's (Allen Ansay) birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: Princess is guilty of hurting Xavier’s feelings!
Episodes.Description: Princess (Sofia Pablo) carries the guilt of ruining Xavier’s (Allen Ansay) birthday celebration, blaming herself for making assumptions about the surprise without knowing his family background.

Episodes.Title: Divina and Sonya’s teamwork is successful
Episodes.Description: Amidst Raymond (Dominic Ochoa) and Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzales) problematic situation, Sonya (Jean Saburit) reveals the real issue of their company to the latter as her way of convincing them that Divina (Denise Laurel) is their chance to save their most-valued organization.

Episodes.Title: Xavier gets involved in an illegal act!
Episodes.Description: While Justin (Radson Flores) offers illegal drugs trying to help Xavier (Allen Ansay) feel better from his issues, the latter refuses to take part in his gimmick. However, it seems too late for Xavier to save himself from the consequences of his friend’s actions.

Episodes.Title: Xavier accounts for his friend's offense!
Episodes.Description: Xavier (Allen Ansay) attempts to reach out to his grandfather to help him, but he gets chased by the cops upon being identified as one of their targets.

Episodes.Title: Xavier's darkest chapter begins!
Episodes.Description: The darkest chapter of Xavier’s (Allen Ansay) life unfolds as he is forced to endure the harsh consequences of a crime he didn’t commit.

Episodes.Title: Liberty distresses Xavier's situation!
Episodes.Description: While Xavier (Allen Ansay) starts to live as one of the inmates, Liberty (Lauren King) sinks into loneliness, losing interest in everything as she cannot stop worrying about her boyfriend’s imprisonment.

Episodes.Title: Xavier has a special visitor in the city jail!
Episodes.Description: Leilani’s (Ayen Munji-Laurel) plea for help heightens Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) urge to tell her about the true situation of Xavier (Allen Ansay). Not long after, the latter accompanies her in the city jail to finally meet her son.

Episodes.Title: Divina’s seductive act becomes obvious!
Episodes.Description: Aside from Mimi (Pauline Mendoza) noticing Divina’s (Denise Laurel) attraction for Raymond (Dominic Ochoa), Sonya (Jean Saburit) also recognizes the latter’s behavior towards her son. Meanwhile, Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) admits that she is aware of Divina’s intentions, but she is still lacking the courage to totally safeguard her husband.

Episodes.Title: The city jail princess guards her prince!
Episodes.Description: While Dado (Keempee De Leon) orders Princess (Sofia Pablo) to stay away from Xavier (Allen Ansay) upon hearing about her intervention to save the latter from the inmates’ attack, she remains concerned and always ready to guard the latter. Meanwhile, Liberty (Lauren King) brainwashes her boyfriend into thinking that Princess is faking her kindness in order to manipulate him.

Episodes.Title: Princess and Sharlene fight back!
Episodes.Description: Princess (Sofia Pablo) refuses to endure any more of Libby’s (Lauren King) abuse and is ready to fight back. At the same time, Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez) faces off against Divina (Denise Laurel) yet again, determined to keep Raymond (Dominic Ochoa) from falling into her hands.

Episodes.Title: Divina finally gets Raymond all to herself
Episodes.Description: The business trip that was supposed to include Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez) gets canceled, leaving Divina (Denise Laurel) to continue the trip alone with Raymond (Dominic Ochoa), giving her the perfect opportunity to seduce him without anyone interfering.

Episodes.Title: Leilani still agonizes her son’s cold heart!
Episodes.Description: As Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel) decides to dine at the canteen of Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) family friend, she cannot keep herself from getting emotional as she opens up about her eagerness to become close to Xavier (Allen Ansay).

Episodes.Title: The wife’s ambush was a little too late!
Episodes.Description: As Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) arrives at the hotel, she immediately heads towards Raymond’s (Dominic Ochoa) room and confronts Divina (Denise Laurel) for doing something illicit towards her husband.

Episodes.Title: Princess captivates her prince’s heart!
Episodes.Description: Onse (Will Ashley) is excited to play the role of the prince because he knows that it could be his chance to finally show his affection for Princess (Sofia Pablo) through acting.

Episodes.Title: The prince professes love for his princess!
Episodes.Description: Xavier (Allen Ansay) gives his best to entertain the audience as he plays the role of the “prince.” Later, Onse (Will Ashley) and Dado (Keempee De Leon) notice that he no longer seems to be acting with Princess (Sofia Pablo) as he professes his romantic side towards her during the roleplay.

Episodes.Title: Leilani is about to expose the truth!
Episodes.Description: Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel) is prepared to tell Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez) the painful truth about Divina (Denise Laurel) swapping their children in the past, but will she be able to do so, especially with the risk of Divina finding out?

Episodes.Title: Divina's dark secret remains hidden!
Episodes.Description: Divina (Denise Laurel) skillfully keeps her enormous secret hidden from Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez), persuading Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel) to remain silent about the truth.

Episodes.Title: Fate exposes Dado’s secret!
Episodes.Description: Leilani’s (Ayen Munji-Laurel) accident after interfering in Princess (Sofia Pablo) and Liberty’s (Lauren King) fight prompts her to unexpectedly return to Dado’s (Keempee De Leon) house to rest. Coincidentally, with Dado outside, he has no time to hide his daughter’s childhood belongings before the two arrive.

Episodes.Title: A reunion comes with a revelation!
Episodes.Description: As Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel) confirms that Princess (Sofia Pablo) is the city jail’s “Baby Girl” after seeing the young woman’s baby pictures, Dado (Keempee De Leon) insists that he cannot risk telling his daughter about her real mother. Meanwhile, Leilani feels guilty because he is also unaware that Divina (Denise Laurel) is not the real mother of Princess.

Episodes.Title: Xavier breaks up with Liberty in prison!
Episodes.Description: While Liberty (Lauren King) grows frustrated as she struggles to find other ways to fix her relationship with Xavier (Allen Ansay), the latter has made up his mind to break up with her.

Episodes.Title: Princess is in a life-or-death situation!
Episodes.Description: Libby (Lauren King) blames Princess (Sofia Pablo) for her breakup with Xavier (Allen Ansay) and accidentally pushes her during a confrontation, putting Princess in a life-or-death situation.

Episodes.Title: Sharlene becomes Princess's lifeline
Episodes.Description: Determined to make amends for what her daughter Libby (Lauren King) did, Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez) is ready to do everything she can to help Dado (Keempee de Leon) save Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) life.

Episodes.Title: The rift between Sharlene and Libby grows!
Episodes.Description: Libby’s (Lauren King) anger toward her mother ignites a heated argument with Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez), pushing their relationship to the edge.

Episodes.Title: The search for Liberty and the answer!
Episodes.Description: While Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) and Divina (Denise Laurel) are in full swing of finding Liberty (Lauren King), Princess (Sofia Pablo) is also steadfast in searching for the answer about her true biological mother.

Episodes.Title: Liberty discovers her biological mother!
Episodes.Description: Liberty’s (Lauren King) alarming state unexpectedly paves the way for Divina (Denise Laurel) to finally confess about being her biological mother.

Episodes.Title: Divina and Liberty team up against Sharlene!
Episodes.Description: Upon confirming her biological relationship with Divina (Denise Laurel), Liberty (Lauren King) agrees to eliminate Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) from their family setup through their secret scheme.

Episodes.Title: Divina and Liberty team up against Sharlene!
Episodes.Description: Upon confirming her biological relationship with Divina (Denise Laurel), Liberty (Lauren King) agrees to eliminate Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) from their family setup through their secret scheme.

Episodes.Title: Princess and Libby's special day
Episodes.Description: As Princess (Sofia Pablo) and Libby (Lauren King) celebrate their birthday at the same time, will everything go smoothly, or will old conflicts resurface?

Episodes.Title: Divina and Libby begin their wicked scheme!
Episodes.Description: Divina (Denise Laurel) and Libby’s (Lauren King) sinister plot unfolds as they prey on Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzalez) fears and orchestrate a nightmare, making her and the Cristobal family believe that Libby has been abducted.

Episodes.Title: The aftermath of Liberty’s disappearance
Episodes.Description: Raymond (Dominic Ochoa) and Sonya (Jean Saburit) are compelled to blame Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) for being irresponsible as Liberty (Lauren King) fakes her disappearance and decides to be with Divina (Denise Laurel).

Episodes.Title: The secret mission fails to sail smoothly!
Episodes.Description: Divina (Denise Laurel) appears to be dealing with a different sequence of events than she expected for her secret plan with Liberty (Lauren King).

Episodes.Title: Liberty falsely accuses two innocents!
Episodes.Description: As soon as Pusoy (Betong Sumaya) is held in police custody, Princess (Sofia Pablo) and her friends work together to help him clear his name. Not long after, Liberty (Lauren King) arrives faking her distress and accuses the latter as the mastermind behind Pusoy’s act of kidnapping.

Episodes.Title: The innocent gets further oppressed!
Episodes.Description: While Pusoy (Betong Sumaya) and Princess (Sofia Pablo) fight to prove their innocence, the police officers have been secretly working with Divina (Denise Laurel), who is trying to convince the Cristobals to accuse the two as the perpetrators.

Episodes.Title: Princess is blamed for Libby’s kidnapping
Episodes.Description: Libby (Lauren King) and Divina (Denise Laurel) are close to victory, and their next step is to pin Princess (Sofia Pablo) for a crime she didn’t commit.

Episodes.Title: The end of Princess and Sharlene’s bond
Episodes.Description: The relationship between Princess (Sofia Pablo) and Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez) will completely fall apart as the latter keeps blaming Princess for Libby’s (Lauren King) abduction.

Episodes.Title: Sharlene asserts her worth as a mother!
Episodes.Description: Divina (Denise Laurel) continues to assert to Raymond (Dominic Ochoa) that every misfortune of Liberty (Laurel King) is a consequence of Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzales) incompetence as a mother, triggering the latter’s outburst on the former’s brainwashing scheme.

Episodes.Title: The innocents fight for truth and freedom!
Episodes.Description: While Princess (Sofia Pablo) receives support from her friends before officially being detained in the Paraluman City Jail, Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel) strives to escape Divina (Denise Laurel) in hopes of finally confessing all her secrets to Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales).

Episodes.Title: The ex-volunteer enters a living hell!
Episodes.Description: As Princess (Sofia Pablo) enters another city jail, her fellow convicts become threatened upon learning about her background as a former volunteer and as someone close to the officers, prompting them to assert their dominance by abusing her.

Episodes.Title: The mother and daughter share a nightmare!
Episodes.Description: While Princess (Sofia Pablo) is living in agony in the city jail, Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) gets arrested again for allegedly killing Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel).

Episodes.Title: The false victory of Divina
Episodes.Description: Divina (Denise Laurel) believed she had succeeded in killing Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel) and framing Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez), but little did she know, Leilani was still alive.

Episodes.Title: Princess and Sharlene's nightmare continues
Episodes.Description: Princess (Sofia Pablo) endures ongoing suffering in prison due to Bane (Sue Prado), while Sharlene (Beauty Gonzalez) once again struggles to prove her innocence and clear her name in the stabbing of Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel).

Episodes.Title: A heartbreaking news worsened Princess' agony
Episodes.Description: While Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) loved ones are focused on resolving their individual problems, the news about Onse’s (Will Ashley) death adds up to their emotional struggle.

Episodes.Title: Princess grieves alone in jail!
Episodes.Description: Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) frustration of not being able to see Onse (Will Ashley) because of her situation adds up to her agony as she grieves for the loss of her best friend.

Episodes.Title: The innocents bitterly reunite in jail!
Episodes.Description: As Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) enters the Paraluman City Jail, Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) grief turns to grudge, triggering her to act fiercely towards the former.

Episodes.Title: Leilani Is Missing
Episodes.Description: Everyone is shocked to discover that Leilani (Ayen Munji-Laurel) is no longer in her room, and no one has any clue where she might be.

Episodes.Title: The desperate search for Leilani
Episodes.Description: Xavier (Allen Ansay) continues his relentless search for answers, desperate to know where his mother is and why she vanished without a trace. Meanwhile, Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzalez) situation takes another dark turn as suspicion begins to surround her once more, this time as the alleged mastermind behind Leilani’s (Ayen Munji-Laurel) disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Divina, sumakses ang mga plano!
Episodes.Description: With Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzalez) relationship with Raymond (Dominic Ochoa) spiraling out of control, Divina (Denise Laurel) uses this moment to manipulate him even more.

Episodes.Title: Divina plans to sabotage Sharlene’s release!
Episodes.Description: Divina (Denise Laurel) appears stunned upon learning that Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) is set to be released, prompting her to desperately seek connections inside the city jail to sabotage the latter.

Episodes.Title: The loving wife and mother returns home!
Episodes.Description: As Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) gets released from jail and finally returns home, she remains determined to fix her bond with her family—unaware that Divina (Denise Laurel) has already caused far more damage than she imagined.

Episodes.Title: Princess finally receives good news!
Episodes.Description: Pusoy (Betong Sumaya) can no longer bear the weight of his guilt, so he finds the courage to fix his wrongdoing by testifying about Princess’ (Sofia Pablo) innocence.

Episodes.Title: Princess and her friends start taking action
Episodes.Description: After being released from jail, Princess (Sofia Pablo) and her friends seek answers regarding their theory that she and Sharlene (Beauty Gonzales) were framed. Meanwhile, the police officer has anticipated that he will be hunted down by the victims, so he prepares to move away.

Episodes.Title: The GUILTY are EXPOSED!
Episodes.Description: During Sonya’s (Jean Saburit) retirement party, Divina (Denise Laurel) intentionally exposes her and Raymond’s (Dominic Ochoa) affair upon Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzales) arrival at the venue. Meanwhile, Justin (Radson Flores) secretly carries out his mission to force Liberty (Lauren King) to admit that her kidnapping incident was a totally made-up story.

Episodes.Title: The husband and daughter are a SHAME!
Episodes.Description: Amidst dealing with her heartbreak upon discovering Raymond’s (Dominic Ochoa) infidelity, Sharlene’s (Beauty Gonzales) distress worsens when she receives the video of Liberty’s (Lauren King) confession about her staged kidnapping incident.

Episodes.Title: Dado’s nightmare shows up in the city jail!
Episodes.Description: When the Cristobals and Pascuals gather in the city jail to settle the planned case against Liberty (Lauren King), everyone–especially Dado (Keempee De Leon)–becomes surprised when Divina (Denise Laurel) intervenes.

Episodes.Title: Divina, muling guguluhin ang buhay ni Dado!
Episodes.Description: Dado’s (Keempee de Leon) worst fear has come true as he and Divina (Denise Laurel) cross paths once again. Will he manage to keep Princess’s (Sofia Pablo) true identity hidden?

Entries.Title: It's Okay to Not Be Okay
Entries.Description: Patrick's life revolves around his nursing job and his brother. But an encounter with Mia, a sadistic children's book author, unlocks buried memories.

Episodes.Title: Once Upon a Same Day
Episodes.Description: Patrick's life revolves around his nursing job and his brother. But an encounter with Mia, a sadistic children's book author, unlocks buried memories.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Finds Us
Episodes.Description: Mia receives news about her father's condition, but refuses to cooperate with his doctors. A patient's escape pulls Patrick into a violent struggle.

Episodes.Title: Shared Past
Episodes.Description: Patrick forgets to secure Mia's autograph for Matthew. But when Vincent invites him to the office, he comes face to face with Mia once again.

Episodes.Title: Never Healed
Episodes.Description: Vincent attempts to buy Patrick's forgiveness. Seeking to keep Patrick in her life, a relentless Mia invites Matmat to her book signing.

Episodes.Title: Made by Scars
Episodes.Description: Patrick recalls painful memories from his childhood days. An excited Matmat attends the author event, but a misunderstanding leads to chaos.

Episodes.Title: Safety Pin
Episodes.Description: Mia's actions lead to a viral moment, and further trouble for Vincent and Madeth. Later, her offer to Patrick is met with cold resistance.

Episodes.Title: Shadow Break
Episodes.Description: In search of peace and stability, Patrick and Matmat return to Maravida. A gossipy vlogger threatens to reveal Mia's biggest secret.

Episodes.Title: Her Red Shoes
Episodes.Description: Matmat connects with his new doctor, giving hope to Patrick. As a storm rages, Mia arrives in Maravida and Patrick recalls a piece of his mother's past.

Episodes.Title: Darkness Returns
Episodes.Description: Gemma confronts Mia about her relationship with Patrick. Later, Mia goes back to her childhood mansion, where a dark presence awaits.

Episodes.Title: Fate Rewinds
Episodes.Description: A patient's return to the hospital leads to a chaotic day for Patrick and the nurses. Matmat reluctantly puts his skills to the test at a new job.

Episodes.Title: Live Your Truth
Episodes.Description: At Mia’s class at the hospital, she shares her unique take on fairy tales. After receiving a paid art job, Matmat reveals his dream purchase to Patrick.

Episodes.Title: Love Slap
Episodes.Description: Mia escapes with a patient, leading to a car chase and chaos at a political rally. Eden and Olivia’s competition takes an unsettling turn.

Episodes.Title: Bad Date
Episodes.Description: Patrick reluctantly spends time with Mia as he considers how to handle her condition. Vincent tracks down Mia, hoping to make her return to Manila.

Episodes.Title: Got Hit
Episodes.Description: Vincent appeals to Patrick for help. Later, he encounters Gemma at a restaurant. The hospital staff scrambles when two unexpected visitors arrive.

Episodes.Title: Empty Can
Episodes.Description: Mia seeks out an enamored Matmat at the hospital, but their meeting draws Patricks's ire. A disturbing encounter occurs between Mia and her father.

Episodes.Title: Rain Knows
Episodes.Description: Patrick struggles with regret after lashing out at Matmat. But when he learns about the attack on Mia, he frantically begins to search for her.

Episodes.Title: Overnight Echoes
Episodes.Description: After getting drenched in the rain, Patrick takes Mia back to his home. But later, she refuses to leave. Matmat accuses Patrick of lying about the slap.

Episodes.Title: Not Owned by You
Episodes.Description: An early-morning encounter between Gemma and Mia turns violent when harsh words are exchanged. Later Patrick tries to pacify Matmat.

Episodes.Title: Work Strings
Episodes.Description: Mia hints at a mysterious new housemate, while a longtime patient eyes Patrick as a match for her daughter. A confession leaves Gemma heartbroken.

Episodes.Title: I Am Mine
Episodes.Description: Matmat's decision to accept a job offer from Mia as her illustrator angers Patrick, causing a rift between the two brothers.

Episodes.Title: He is Back
Episodes.Description: Patrick makes a decision to support Matmat's new job - but he has conditions. Vincent reveals his company woes to Madelyn.

Episodes.Title: Within Mansion Walls
Episodes.Description: On the brothers' first night at Mia's home, she tells Matmat a disturbing tale. A man who used to work with Patrick's mother gives him a warning.

Episodes.Title: Daughter to Her
Episodes.Description: As Matpat works on the pairing at the hospital, Dr. Ano asks him an unsettling question. A conversation with a patient leaves Mia in shock.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Shadow
Episodes.Description: Haunted by memories, Mia seeks comfort as she struggles to cope. After several incidents, the hospital staff makes a decision regarding Mia's classes.

Episodes.Title: Pull Closer
Episodes.Description: After learning about her hallucinations, Vincent and Madeth try to force Mia to leave the house, but Patrick steps in.

Episodes.Title: Clear Moment
Episodes.Description: Mia tells Patrick about her dream, while Gemma and Vincent cross paths at a karaoke bar. Later, Dr. Anok asks Patrick about his relationship with Mia.

Episodes.Title: Meet Satsat
Episodes.Description: After coming home drunk, Patrick gives Mia a gift with her nightmares. To find out more about Olivia, Eden suggests bonding over a drinking game.

Episodes.Title: Unleashed
Episodes.Description: Mia returns to the hospital, leading to run-ins with Elvie and her father. Eden finds a curious letter in Samuel's bed.

Episodes.Title: Little Traces
Episodes.Description: Mia makes a decision to change her look, but Matmat doesn't approve. Madeth finds out more about Gemma for a smitten Vincent.

Episodes.Title: Slowly Together
Episodes.Description: Dr. Anok asks Patrick to keep a close eye on Zelda, a patient, after she begins acting strangely. Mia, Patrick and Matmat share a light moment together.

Episodes.Title: Not Hers
Episodes.Description: When Matmat sees Mia holding Satsat, the two begin to fight, tearing the doll in half. Eden has an unsettling conversation with Samuel.

Episodes.Title: Rivalries
Episodes.Description: Vincent and Madeth make themselves at home at Mama Li's house, despite Jason's annoyance. Matmat apologizes to Mia-but it comes with a warning.

Episodes.Title: Is This Love?
Episodes.Description: While discussing Kai's secret relationship, Patrick reflects on his feelings for Mia. Bella grows emotional during Mia's class at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Out of Routine
Episodes.Description: After Patrick defends Mia from Jerome, he receives a 10-day suspension. But his plan for a romantic getaway soon comes to a screeching halt.

Episodes.Title: Cut Short
Episodes.Description: Mia and Patrick make amends, but their intimate moment is interrupted. Gemma opens up to Macbeth, who gives her some frank advice.

Entries.Title: Linlang
Entries.Description: Victor Lualhati is a former boxer turned seaman. All he wants in life is a complete and happy family with his wife, Juliana. Being away for a long time, Victor decides to take some time off from work to be with his family. However, as days pass, he notices significant changes in his wife. He then comes across a suspicious message from an unknown number on Juliana's phone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Victor Lualhati is a former boxer turned seaman. All he wants in life is a complete and happy family with his wife, Juliana. Being away for a long time, Victor decides to take some time off from work to be with his family. However, as days pass, he notices significant changes in his wife. He then comes across a suspicious message from an unknown number on Juliana's phone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Juliana explains to Victor the reasons behind her sinful actions. However, Victor struggles to accept her explanation, leading to escalating domestic issues that put their daughter, Abby, in jeopardy. Determined to move forward, Victor attempts to put the betrayal behind him, only to stumble upon a shocking revelation: the true identity of Juliana's paramour.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Leaving no stone left unturned, Victor continues to investigate and befriends Juliana’s officemates to confirm the identity of his wife's paramour. Victor collapses during his boxing training and cleverly uses his medical predicament to entrap Juliana’s lover, which culminates in a bloody confrontation. Meanwhile, Amelia discovers Juliana's dark secret during the most important day of her career.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Victor reveals to the authorities that Juliana and Alex are having an extramarital affair. However, he lacks the concrete evidence needed to support his claim. To make matters worse, Sylvia's involvement in the matter adds to the complexity of the situation when she clears her husband’s name. Later, Juliana seeks an annulment citing Victor's psychological incapacity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Victor and Juliana are compelled to live together in the big house for Abby's sake. Surprisingly, their family dynamic starts to resemble what it used to be, triggering jealousy in Alex. Sylvia struggles with infertility and considers adoption as an option. Juliana discovers this, creating a rift in her relationship with Alex and putting their affair at risk of being exposed to their families.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As Juliana plans to sell their house to push her estranged husband to the limit, Victor returns to professional boxing with the help of an unlikely ally to provide for his family. Alex becomes a law firm partner. As the stakes get higher, Juliana makes a life-changing discovery that will ruin her and Alex for good. Suspicious of his wife’s actions, Victor stops at nothing to uncover her secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Kate feels betrayed after discovering her sister’s dirty secret with her own eyes. Tension escalates when Juliana receives a malicious after-party photo of Victor. Even after the DNA test proves that he is the father of Juliana's unborn child, Victor remains skeptical about the result. The uncertainty causes anxiety for everyone, and yet only one person among them already has the answer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After Juliana's attempted escape, Victor denies her access to Abby and keeps the child hidden away. However, witnessing Abby's distraught, Victor decides to negotiate with Juliana, offering to hold adultery charges in exchange for the child's custody. Despite Juliana's reluctance, she eventually agrees to the deal, until another deceitful plan occurs that only deepens Victor's mistrust of her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As the adultery court hearing looms, Victor taps the strongest witness he can find against Alex—his devoted wife, Sylvia. While seeking funds for his legal battle, Victor makes yet another earth-shattering discovery about his identity. Out of desperation, Alex and Juliana endanger the most important aspect of their relationship—their unborn child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: The loss of Juliana and Alex’s unborn child affects everyone, including Victor. To make matters worse, serious legal problems loom over the illicit couple now that Victor finally obtains solid evidence against them. Sylvia's love for Alex ends in a devastating tragedy. After a few years, many things have changed, and Victor's next steps will soon be revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After spending years in prison, Victor seeks to redeem all he has lost, especially his relationship with his daughter Abby. However, Juliana still harbors doubts about him, making it uncertain whether he can prove his innocence and regain the trust of those close to him. Meanwhile, Alex hopes to become a partner with Emilio's company, only to face opposition from an unknown source.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As Alex and Emilio’s partnership is in shambles, Victor tricks his brother into signing with a new boxing promotion. Things are slowly falling into place for Victor when he starts to regain Abby's affection and finally ties the knot with Olivia. Alex investigates the identity of the person who helps his brother, while Victor uncovers another lie concerning Sylvia’s demise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Victor orchestrates a plan to expose Alex's infidelity and abusive behavior toward Juliana. Filled with regrets for leaving Victor, Juliana finds herself in turmoil. Jealous of the ex-couple's rekindled connection, Olivia decides to intervene. However, her plan to drive Juliana away from her and Victor's lives takes a shocking turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: While Olivia remains missing, a battered Juliana comes home to Alex. Just when Victor finally acquires a video that could solve Sylvia's murder, Alex turns himself in to the authorities to make a confession. Meanwhile, Amelia is forced to choose between her principles and her son. In a death match between Alex and Victor, only one Lualhati emerges victorious.

Entries.Title: Voltes V: Legacy
Entries.Description: The Earth is under attack by an alien menace known as the Boazanian Forces. A special group of people who have been properly trained to deal with this kind of emergency pilots the Voltes V robot to fight and defend humanity.

Episodes.Title: Voltes V vs. the Boazanian Empire
Episodes.Description: The Earth is under attack by an alien menace known as the Boazanian Forces. A special group of people who have been properly trained to deal with this kind of emergency pilots the Voltes V robot to fight and defend humanity.

Episodes.Title: Hrothgar’s revolt against the Boazanians
Episodes.Description: Hrothgar demonstrates his capabilities with his impressive inventions and generous demeanor and is soon selected to be the next ruler of Boazania. However, Zambojil, the son of the late emperor, becomes determined to prevent this from happening.

Episodes.Title: Hrothgar meets Mary Ann
Episodes.Description: Hrothgar and slave rebels battle the Boazanian soldiers. Before they are captured, the rebels aid Hrothgar's escape with his airship. He pledges to return and rescue the rebels from the empire.

Episodes.Title: Terra Erthu’s ‘Voltes V’ Project
Episodes.Description: Mary Ann gives Hrothgar a new name, Ned Armstrong. They soon fall in love and have two sons, Steve and Big Bert. Meanwhile, Ned and the Earth's leaders build Camp Big Falcon, the base for the powerful robot Voltes V.

Episodes.Title: Camp Big Falcon's greatest weapon
Episodes.Description: Ned returns to Boazan to fulfill his promise and free the hornless slaves from Emperor Zambojil. In Boazan, Emperor Zambojil tells the young Zardoz about his treacherous father. Zardoz remains loyal to the Empire.

Episodes.Title: Takeover
Episodes.Description: Dr. Smith introduces the five Volt machines to the cadets. As Ned returns to planet Boazan, the Boazan soldiers try to capture him.

Episodes.Title: Alpha Team
Episodes.Description: Zardoz bids Boazan farewell to invade planet Earth. Steve faces a military officer who thinks that he is arrogant and fires at him.

Episodes.Title: Destiny to Fulfill
Episodes.Description: Zardoz' generals inform him that they could hasten their voyage to Earth and reach Terra Erthu in a month's time. Meanwhile, Mary Ann discovers that Little Jon had gone to the forbidden area.

Episodes.Title: Earth on Alert
Episodes.Description: The Armstrong brothers are now suspicious of their superhuman abilities and will go to any length to discover the truth.

Episodes.Title: World Under Attack
Episodes.Description: The Boazanian empire led by Zardoz finally arrived at Terra Erthu to conquer the world where Hrothgar was hiding. What steps will Camp Big Falcon take to save their world?

Episodes.Title: Volt In
Episodes.Description: The Voltes team is finally revealed! Will the team win against the strength of the Boazanian empire to save planet Earth from destruction?

Episodes.Title: Sanib Pwersa
