Episodes.Description: As the Escaleras meet at Isabel's to discuss the master list, JB and Andres clash over the hard drive. Miguel fears he's being followed.

Episodes.Title: Head
Episodes.Description: After Andres asks JB for more time with the hard drive, Greg discusses the new contract with him. Miguel tries to make amends with his family.

Episodes.Title: Lifeline
Episodes.Description: Time is running out for Andres as Greg orders the team to find Isabel. He enters a high-stakes negotiation with the Escalera matriarch.

Episodes.Title: The Killing List
Episodes.Description: A string of high-profile assassinations sparks tension within the Escalera family. Isabel blackmails Andres to get the hard drive back.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Protector
Episodes.Description: The team zeroes in on Diamond and the gang, but as assailants arrive on the scene, Andres must make a confession. JB rushes to protect his father.

Episodes.Title: Departure
Episodes.Description: Andres tries to evade the mystery attackers and get Isabel to safety. JB defends his father while the rest of the team continues the mission.

Episodes.Title: Mad Man
Episodes.Description: While Andres helps Isabel escape, she entrusts him with a message. Max reveals the truth about the hard drive to Greg.

Episodes.Title: Face the Music
Episodes.Description: After the mission ends, Greg and JB have a heart-to-heart about the hard drive and Andres. Meanwhile, masked men abduct Miguel.

Episodes.Title: Crackdown
Episodes.Description: Greg goes through Andres' file, while Gabriela confronts her father after he sells a beloved house. JB vows to take down the Elcano organization.

Episodes.Title: No Surrender
Episodes.Description: Max returns her fiance's ring to his mother, leading to a heartfelt conversation. Andres faces the team after the fallout of their last mission.

Episodes.Title: Brand New Day
Episodes.Description: Greg takes on a contract to take down Sameo Patel, a drug trafficker with suspicious ties. Andres considers buying back his family's land.

Episodes.Title: Mountain
Episodes.Description: A bad investment forces Tomas' godfather into hiding. Miguel tightens security around Christine and his son. JB leads the team into their mission.

Episodes.Title: Tropic Storm
Episodes.Description: While the team camps near a village, Miguel sees Sameo's subordinates heading for their campsite. Greg learns the truth about his friend.

Episodes.Title: Passage
Episodes.Description: Andres send guards to protect his family, but his grandmother is weary. Meanwhile, a storm arrives as the team heads to Sameo's stronghold.

Episodes.Title: Storage
Episodes.Description: The team pushes to complete the mission in heavy rain and Greg talks to Claire — his friend's wife — about what happened to her husband.

Episodes.Title: Loot
Episodes.Description: After clearing the hideout, the team splits up on route to the exit point. But a young member of Sameo's gang soon warns the others.

Episodes.Title: Desperados
Episodes.Description: On the way out of Mt. Talimba, Andres and Miguel discuss their financial needs while Max and Gabriela search for their missing horse, while JB and Tomas realize that they are being hunted.

Episodes.Title: Boy
Episodes.Description: Andres and Miguel try to make a daring rescue. Max and Gabriela search for their missing horse, while JB and Tomas realize that they are being hunted.

Episodes.Title: Money Matters
Episodes.Description: Andres wrestles with guilt over leaving the girl behind, while Tomas and JB struggle with the long journey and reflect on the past.

Episodes.Title: Intentions
Episodes.Description: A villager sees Andres and Miguel and seeks medical assistance. Meanwhile, Rita finds her brother, but he won't leave until he finds the intruders.

Episodes.Title: Gray Area
Episodes.Description: JB and Timas hide from Sameo's gang, while a hiker's scream briefly pulls Gabriela and Max away from their bags of money.

Episodes.Title: Cash Flow
Episodes.Description: As Andres and Miguel exchange fire with Emer, JB and Tomas escape from their assailants. Meanwhile, Max and Gabriela discover a devious trick.

Episodes.Title: Payback
Episodes.Description: While searching for the two hikers, Max and Gabriela face off against Benjie and his men. Andres assists a wounded Miguel.

Episodes.Title: All for the Family
Episodes.Description: Andres' grandmother confronts him about the money, while Gabriela gives her dad part of the payment for the old house, sparking an emotional talk.

Episodes.Title: Secret Contact
Episodes.Description: As Miguel and Christine talk about their son's future, Max gives back an orphanage and Greg unexpectedly turns down a contract.

Episodes.Title: Checking In
Episodes.Description: Gabriela has Tomas spy on her father's mistress. Meanwhile, Greg mulls over Isabel's last words as Andres hunts for a lead on his brother.

Episodes.Title: Option
Episodes.Description: Unable to reach Miguel, Greg briefs the team without him on their next mission: to capture assasssin Kenji Lee and find out who hired him.

Episodes.Title: Kaigen
Episodes.Description: With his father's condition worsening under custody, JB grows more determined to free him as the team gets ready to go to Kaigen in pursuit of Kenji.

Episodes.Title: Snowfall
Episodes.Description: While the team adjusts to the cold, they realize they're not the only ones hunting Kenji. With his family in peril, Miguel seeks help from Andres.

Episodes.Title: Bad Weather
Episodes.Description: As Greg reunites with and old friend, Max gets an important phone call while Gabriela decides to split from Tomas to survey the area in peace.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Storm
Episodes.Description: While looking for Gabriela, the team shifts focus when Andres spots Kenji. Back in the Philippines, Miguel shakes off his family's stalkers.

Episodes.Title: Frozen
Episodes.Description: Greg talks to a despondent Andres after the team hits a snag in the mission. Tomas opens up about his brother, while Max's news to gives hope to JB.

Episodes.Title: Snow Drift
Episodes.Description: As Max talks to Andres about loss and moving on, JB reflects on his last conversation with his father. Meanwhile, Miguel prepares for a showdown.

Episodes.Title: Slippery Slope
Episodes.Description: JB trails Kenji on a daring snowmobile chase as the rest of the team closes in. But things get complicated when the local mafia joins the hunt.

Episodes.Title: Blood on the Snow
Episodes.Description: To find Kenji, Max uses city cameras and tracks him down. Andres' grandmother goes to the agency to confirm the news about Jun.

Episodes.Title: Cold Blood
Episodes.Description: Unable to move due to his condition, JB helplessly watches as Tomas fends off the Rai Jins alone. Meanwhile, Miguel continues his onslaught.

Episodes.Title: Departures
Episodes.Description: Rattled by Kenji's words, the team questions whether they should complete the contract or not. Greg makes a call to determine their course of action.

Episodes.Title: Traitors
Episodes.Description: As Andres reunites with his family, he and his grandmother discuss their suspicions about Jun. Elsewhere, Max voices concerns about JB's father's case.

Episodes.Title: Enduring Love
Episodes.Description: After the Kaigen mission, the team reunites for another get-together with Miguel. Later, Andres' grandmother urges him to move on from his search.

Episodes.Title: One Step Closer
Episodes.Description: JB turns into a violent as he pursues the man who conned him. Tomas goes on his first date with Agnes, while Gab confronts Shari at a yoga class.

Episodes.Title: Love and Drugs
Episodes.Description: A meeting with a young man raises new suspicions for Andres. As Gabriela breaks down over her mother's death, her father issues an ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: Bad Ideas
Episodes.Description: Gabriela struggles to reclaim her mother's resthouse, but Tomas has an idea. JB and Max continue plotting against the El Cano group.

Episodes.Title: Contractfully Yours
Episodes.Description: JB and Max get a possible lead on the El Cano organization. Tomas tells Ninong about his deal with Gabriela, while Gab speaks to her father.

Episodes.Title: Brother
Episodes.Description: While Greg searches for Raven, he remembers the mission that cost him his team their lives. Gabriela's father confronts Tomas, questioning his intentions.

Episodes.Title: Promises to Keep
Episodes.Description: After Dexter's meet-up with Manuel, JB and Max tail the target's car. Gabriela and Tomas move forward with their plan under her father's watchful eye.

Episodes.Title: Suspicions
Episodes.Description: As a celebration unfolds in Andres' home, Gabriela and Tomas endure an awkward dinner with her father and Ninong as they try not to blow their cover.

Episodes.Title: Collision Course
Episodes.Description: Unfazed by Diego's odd behavior, Andres talks to his grandmother about reclaiming their land. The next day, Greg briefs the team on their new mission.

Episodes.Title: At All Costs
Episodes.Description: Seeking to trail Diego, JB and Greg keep watch on Andres, while Max and Miguel comb through an event's guest list for suspicious names.

Episodes.Title: Home
Episodes.Description: As Andres confronts Diego about whether he's been avoiding him, Gabriela grows emotional over an unexpected gift from her father.

Episodes.Title: Meet Up
Episodes.Description: After clashing with Greg, Andres cools off with JB's help as the three reach a compromise on the mission. Meanwhile, Tomas runs into and old classmate.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: When the target leaves after meeting Andres, Greg and JB follow him to his base. Elsewhere, Gabriela presses Tomas about a woman he was seen with.

Episodes.Title: Gathering
Episodes.Description: As a charity event begins, the team prepares for the mission head of Sec. Barrios' arrival. Buth they might not be the only ones surveilling the area.

Episodes.Title: The Uninvited
Episodes.Description: The team scrambles when an unexpected guest arrives but they continue to prioritize the target. Gabriela confronts a potentially compromised Tomas.

Episodes.Title: Party at High Noon
Episodes.Description: While Diego executes his group's plans, Max notifies her team about an unusual activity at the party. Greg and his former comrade corner Manuel at an unlikely place in an attempt to settle old scores.

Episodes.Title: Death is Calling
Episodes.Description: The mission grows complicated when Miguel mistakes a musician for a threat and Sec. Barrios veers off-program. Meanwhile, Greg confronts on an old friend.

Episodes.Title: In Plain Sight
Episodes.Description: Fearing for Ninong's life, Tomas follows the orders of an unknown caller. Max fills Greg in on the unexpected guest and Miguel's theory about the mix-up.

Episodes.Title: Panic Room
Episodes.Description: When an emergency occurs at the event, the team grows concerned when Tomas begins acting suspiciously, prompting Andres to tail him.

Episodes.Title: Puppeteer
Episodes.Description: Torn between completing the mission and protecting Tomas, the team decides to split up. Gabriela goes to help Ninong after Max gives her potential leads.

Episodes.Title: The Decision to Kill
Episodes.Description: As Gabriela continues to search for Ninong, the caller gives Tomas a shocking directive, Meanwhile, Max tells Greg about the snag mission.

Episodes.Title: Done For
Episodes.Description: The clock is ticking as Andres tries to stop the caller from pushing through with the plan, while Tomas moves to fulfill the final command.

Episodes.Title: Crossfire
Episodes.Description: A hallway shootout results in multiple casualties — and one hits close to home for Andres. Max, Tomas and Miguel rush to evacuate the area.

Episodes.Title: Devastation
Episodes.Description: As the team scrambles to get urgent medical care for the shootout victims, Miguel rushes to Andres' side while he anxiously waits for an update.

Episodes.Title: The Dead and the Dying
Episodes.Description: When Tomas mentions backing out of his job, he and Gabriela get some advice. Meanwhile, Miguel tries to support Andres through a difficult time.

Episodes.Title: Sudden Impact
Episodes.Description: While Andres confronts Manuel about the shootout, Tomas joins Gabriela to meet her father, but a surprise encounter with an armed man derails their plan.

Episodes.Title: What You Wish For
Episodes.Description: Greg arrives at Andres' home to pay respects, but meets resistance. Andres works to buy his family's land and JB seeks to keep his injuries a secret.

Episodes.Title: All Said and Done
Episodes.Description: Andres' grandmother urges him to let go of the past, while JB shares good news with his father. Missing his family, Miguel marks an important milestone.

Episodes.Title: Death on the Horizon
Episodes.Description: While Andres and his family celebrate with the community, Gabriela is caught off guard when she sees her father calling Tomas phone.

Episodes.Title: Fall Out
Episodes.Description: Tomas gets surprising news from Ninong, urging him to return home. A child delivers a suspicious package to Max's house as JB goes to pick up his father.

Episodes.Title: The Killing Time
Episodes.Description: After receiving news of a threat, the team realizes they might not be the only targets and frantically rush home to protect their loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Bloodshed
Episodes.Description: Manuel's plan swings into action, sending the team reeling. Noticing his silence, Andres' grandmother asks if he misses life in the city.

Episodes.Title: Vendetta
Episodes.Description: While Greg and Miguel keep watch over a devastated Max, Gabriela tries to make amends with her father before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: No Turning Back
Episodes.Description: After an emotional update from Miguel about the state of the team following the Barrios mission, Andres agrees to meet with Greg.

Episodes.Title: Bullets
Episodes.Description: Greg calls in reinforcements as the team prepares to launch their attack on Manuel's potential stronghold while rescuing the children imprisoned there.

Episodes.Title: War
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the strike, Greg and the team air out their grief and grievances as they come to terms with the cost of their mission.

Episodes.Title: Split
Episodes.Description: Andres and JB reconcile over their losses. After witnessing cruelty at the stronghold, Tomas and Gabriela wants to act, but Miguel urges caution.

Episodes.Title: We Move as a Team
Episodes.Description: The team carefully advances through the stronghold. But before they can attempt their strike, Andres must reach the kidnapped children.

Episodes.Title: Get Your Guns Out
Episodes.Description: Max lands in trouble when El Cano operatives swarm around her, while Andres' team discovers there are more children being held captive.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Darkness
Episodes.Description: Caught in a perilous shoot-out, Gabriel and Tomas take a moment to make peace. Meanwhile, Andres attempts to honor a child's request.

Episodes.Title: This Time for Heroes
Episodes.Description: Greg and the gang try to lure Manuel and the rest of El Cano out with threats of gunfire. But when they're nowhere to be seen, the team gets suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Bad Time to Die
Episodes.Description: Danger continues as the team spots bomb traps in the buildings. Greg realizes the El Cano is using a sinister weapon for deadly attacks.

Episodes.Title: Kontraktwalistas
Episodes.Description: Andres and Tomas attempt to rescue a teammate in trouble as El Cano forces threaten to gun them down. JB's condition puts him and Max in a bind.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: As JB and Max try to escape El Cano operatives, they must fend off Manuel's right hand man. Meanwhile Miguel helps out Gabriela.

Episodes.Title: Exit Point
Episodes.Description: While JB and Max continue the fight against Manuel's henchman, Greg confronts an old friend to finish the mission once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Love and Honor
Episodes.Description: As Greg vows to take down El Cano, Gabriela discuss their relationship, while Andres gets a visitor he wasn't expecting.

Entries.Title: Bad Genius: The Series
Entries.Description: On Lin's first day at Colegio de San Gabriel Possenti, she meets Grace, and they instantly click. When Lin volunteers to tutor her for an upcoming long test, she discovers that their teacher has been selling test leakages for a price.

Episodes.Title: New Girl
Episodes.Description: On Lin's first day at Colegio de San Gabriel Possenti, she meets Grace, and they instantly click. When Lin volunteers to tutor her for an upcoming long test, she discovers that their teacher has been selling test leakages for a price.

Episodes.Title: The Wash Boy
Episodes.Description: Lin, Grace, and Pat’s cheating scheme is in full swing until Bank, Lin’s biggest academic rival, gets in the way.

Episodes.Title: The Drama Queen
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Lin's help, Grace lands the lead role in the school's theater play. Just when everything seems to be going smoothly for Lin and her 'clients,' a cheat sheet is confiscated—from a student outside their circle.

Episodes.Title: The Frog Prince
Episodes.Description: Pat begins to suspect that Grace is hiding something from him. Meanwhile, Lin and Bank's growing friendship starts to turn into something more, until Bank uncovers a side of Lin that might change everything.

Episodes.Title: Things Fall Apart
Episodes.Description: After Bank discovers her role in the exam-cheating scheme, she tries to explain her side. But when Lin learns that Grace has betrayed her, she begins to question every decision she’s made.

Episodes.Title: Strange Territory
Episodes.Description: As Lin tries to move on from the trouble she created in Possenti, she is offered a new opportunity to turn cheat sheets into big money by scheming an international standardized exam.

Episodes.Title: Down Under
Episodes.Description: Lin recruits Bank for their biggest scheme yet, where the stakes and risks have never been higher. But before it even begins, Bank uncovers a shocking truth about Pat's cruel intention that makes him question whether this path was ever his choice.

Episodes.Title: The Test
Episodes.Description: The STIC exam begins and so is Lin, Bank, Pat and Grace's biggest cheating scheme to date. As the stakes get higher, their emotions soar to the extreme.

Entries.Title: My Husband's Wife
Entries.Description: After fighting for their love for years, Christy (Jasmine Curtis-Smith) and Jordan (Rayver Cruz) finally exchange their vows in front of the people close to their hearts. What kind of married life awaits them?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1 - World Premiere
Episodes.Description: After fighting for their love for years, Christy (Jasmine Curtis-Smith) and Jordan (Rayver Cruz) finally exchange their vows in front of the people close to their hearts. What kind of married life awaits them?

Episodes.Title: Episode 2 - Secret Movement
Episodes.Description: Shaira (Liezel Lopez) helps the activists so she can have Jordan (Rayver Cruz) all to herself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3 - Nightmare
Episodes.Description: After shooting Jordan (Rayver Cruz), the armed men abducted Christy (Jasmine Curtis-Smith). Will the help arrive before his life is in jeopardy?

Episodes.Title: Episode 4 - Dying
Episodes.Description: While Jordan (Rayver Cruz) still fights for his life after getting shot, Christy (Jasmine Curtis-Smith) suffers at the hands of the armed men as one of them tries to harass her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5 - Escape
Episodes.Description: Christy (Jasmine Curtis-Smith) disguised as one of the Kalasags and tries to escape. Will she be able to join them without being noticed?

Episodes.Title: Episode 6-Mourning
Episodes.Description: Jordan (Rayver Cruz) begs the congressman to give him information about the rebel’s home base

Episodes.Title: Episode 7-Death
Episodes.Description: Cristy’s (Jasmine Curtis-Smith) family grieves and gives her a funeral after seeing the video of her getting shot by the kalasags.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8 - Hell
Episodes.Description: When Leon (Joem Bascon) learns that Cristy (Jasmine Curtis-Smith) is trying to escape, she gives her a lesson she will never forget.

Entries.Title: Avenues of the Diamond
Entries.Description: Sam is a friendly communications student and party girl from a wealthy political family. Clyden is a studious but snobby med student who hates Sam’s family. But one day, these opposites suddenly find themselves arranged to be married, with seemingly no way to escape.

Episodes.Title: The Senator's Daughter and The Activist
Episodes.Description: Sam is a friendly communications student and party girl from a wealthy political family. Clyden is a studious but snobby med student who hates Sam’s family. But one day, these opposites suddenly find themselves arranged to be married, with seemingly no way to escape.

Episodes.Title: The House on Ligaya Street
Episodes.Description: Sam and Clyden are forced to live together. Now, their already contentious relationship gets even worse as they try to adjust to each other’s very different lifestyles.

Episodes.Title: Maui
Episodes.Description: Sam and Clyden start to get along. But as their bond deepens and their friendship grows, does their deal to break off the engagement still stand?

Episodes.Title: Backburner?
Episodes.Description: Sam is in denial of having any feelings for Clyden. But when she finds herself jealous of Clyden’s closeness with a female classmate, Sam just grows more confused.

Episodes.Title: For Real This Time
Episodes.Description: After the unexpected kiss from Clyden, Sam distances herself from him in hopes of figuring out her feelings. But a surprise visit from Clyden makes it harder to deny the truth any longer.

Episodes.Title: When You Know, You Know
Episodes.Description: As Clyden admits that he thinks he’s fallen in love with Sam, their relationship grows even deeper. On the other hand, Sam’s relationship with half-sister Naomi turns for the worse. With Clyden’s support, can Sam turn her relationship with her sister around?

Episodes.Title: Nothing Like The First Time
Episodes.Description: Sam and Clyden are officially together, and Sam and Naomi have finally made up. But just as things have gone great for Sam, Clyden seems to have forgotten about her birthday.

Episodes.Title: Better Days
Episodes.Description: Sam and Clyden’s love grows deeper as they continue to celebrate important moments together. But as they also pursue their dreams together, their families aren’t as supportive.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of the End
Episodes.Description: Sam and Clyden are finally starting to live their dreams. But that also means having less time for each other. Can they be there for each other when a huge scandal tests their families?

Episodes.Title: See You Around
Episodes.Description: After Clyden’s mom’s plea for Sam and Clyden to break up, Sam gets another devastating news. And this time, there might be no saving their relationship.

Episodes.Title: The Supermodel And The Doctor
Episodes.Description: It’s been four years since Sam and Clyden’s break up. They have finally achieved their dreams. And now, it seems fate is leading them back to each other. But have they already moved on?

Episodes.Title: A Little Hope Never Hurt
Episodes.Description: When Sam falls ill, she finds herself being taken care of by Clyden once again. Is this the start of a rekindling of their romance?

Episodes.Title: All The Things Left Unsaid
Episodes.Description: Sam meets up with Clyden in the guise of friendly hang outs. But as they do so, their past keeps coming up. Will they finally be able to talk about all their hang-ups from the past?

Episodes.Title: All We Have Is Now
Episodes.Description: As Sam’s best friend, Yanna, is set to get married, she ponders on her relationship with Clyden. Is there still a future for them when she’s about to leave for New York?

Episodes.Title: Everything We Left Behind
Episodes.Description: A video of Sam admitting her relationship with Clyden spreads like wildfire. And with netizens speculating on the seemingly questionable relationship and digging into her past, Sam receives a ton of backlash. Will their relationship once again fall apart due to a scandal?

Episodes.Title: Finally Free
Episodes.Description: It’s been three years since Sam left the Philippines. But now, she’s back for good, opening a new club, and starting a new life. Will Clyden be a part of Sam’s new life or will they never get their happily ever after?
